yes, fifth tenure behavior... but the importance of things proven wrong does persist. that's experience. but it must carry that it's proven wrong when revisited.

is this a place that might need confidence scores instead of binary answers?

Well, lets review our intentions: it should be a chatbot. it should persist. it should be able to do research, a task that can be protracted and have many steps. which means it needs to be able to plan and track progress on that plan. contradiction will happen. it happens inside my head all the time and has to be resolved. there's even a linguistic term for it tho i forget it now. to speak something and then moments later to revise based on things remembered in the mean time. and given this things persistence that could happen. so how does it look now? as to the WATCHME, that's easy. add a probe to ask akien about it later. :)

i liked your note about being able to cite back to changes too. that should be part of this.

yes, it has to land in the queue you'll prompt me about via the hooks. two tickets sounds good.
